consequence.statement: Visual rendering of logs in web UI improves; no operational consequence

original.statement: Web UI log display line height increased to fix overlapping lines visual issue.

decision.reason: [ev-d0bac62ab0c7] lists this only as a bug fix that "fixes overlapping lines in logs by increasing line height". That is a display change. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated, and no default or behaviour that an operator relies on changes. So kind "none" (informational) is supported. The statement's mention of the "web UI" is an inference, since the excerpt does not name the UI, but it fits the line-height wording and does not change the kind.
